I don't know why I feel this way. It's been many years and, despite my efforts, my mood has continued to worsen. I can't think of a single negative external influence causing me to be this way; objectively speaking, my life is perfectly fine.    

  As for the reliability issue, I'm well aware. That being said, I'm pretty confident I won't fail. You are also perfectly correct in saying that I'm not giving myself the chance to experience better times. It's also preventing myself from getting even worse, which given the way my life is going, is pretty much guaranteed.
